topicA: AI Visibility and Search Optimization for B2B

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing: understanding how your brand shows up in AI search results and crafting effective content strategies.
bullets: While AI tools like ChatGPT send very little direct traffic, appearing in AI answers can act as a valuable "digital billboard" for brand building.
For B2B content to truly convert, it must directly address the specific problems and challenges that potential business customers are experiencing.
Despite widespread AI use in marketing, proving the financial return of automated efforts remains a top challenge for many teams.
Even with AI providing faster insights, companies often struggle to use this information effectively due to a lack of trust or internal collaboration.
recap.closing: This week you learned that a clear strategy and strong internal collaboration are key to making both AI and content marketing truly effective.
